reviewerOrPass: Worker B, same AI, separate source-first pass
method: Re-extracted the adopted regulations from a separately retrieved PDF, revisited the dated catalogue pages and module contents, checked credit totals and entry order, then opened the frozen comparator and reconsidered each aligned relationship and course schedule against the active workbook.
findings: The adopted curriculum contains five compulsory 30 EC modules and 30 EC of elective space. The catalogue confirms the 60 EC per year plan. Connections and Structures list cumulative prerequisites satisfied by the first four terms. The adopted rule requires Structures before Capstone. The final capstone has a research report and implemented digital intervention, and the fifth-semester internship remains elective.

Data preparation, prototyping, stakeholder analysis and predictive modelling are direct but bounded relationships to the first four modules. The regional sustainability project shares partner-based investigation with the capstone. Its task is research, while UvA also requires implementation. Optional independent research stays separate from scheduled credits. The elective space stands alone.

The broad plan combines computation and social science with behavioural evaluation and public interventions. The climate plan covers GIS and spatial planning for environmental decisions, with no dedicated health or mobility systems module. The AI plan combines more advanced models with an explicit ethics course and social analysis of inequality. Schedules and course claims agree with the active workbook. Titles, concepts and limits describe the completed choices.
